title: Missed Anthropic's record IPO? Shares cool off after Nasdaq debut - Here's how Indians can invest | Stock Market News
text:
Anthropic share price: Claude chatbot maker Anthropic made a stellar stock market debut on Thursday, surpassing even SpaceX's June listing. However, the euphoria surrounding the AI giant proved short-lived, with its shares witnessing a correction in pre-market trading on Friday, November 20. Despite the pullback, Anthropic shares continued to trade above their IPO price, retaining a portion of their listing-day gains.

For Indian investors who missed the blockbuster IPO, there are still ways to gain exposure to the AI giant's shares after its Nasdaq debut. Here's how they can invest in Anthropic.

Indian residents can invest in shares of Anthropic and other US-listed companies through international brokerage platforms under the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)'s Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS).

Interactive Brokers, Vested Finance, and INDmoney are some of the brokerage platforms which let Indian investors to buy US-listed stocks under RBI's LRS.

-First step is to open an international investment account. Investors are required to register with a brokerage platform of their choice which provides access to Nasdaq listed stocks.

-Second step is to complete KYC by submitting PAN, identity and address documents and complete the required verification.

-The third step is to transfer funds from Indian bank account to international brokerage account through LRS. Your funds will be automatically converted into US dollars.

-Once your account reflects the transferred amount of money, you have to search on the platform for 'Anthropic' and purchase the required amount of shares by placing a 'Buy' order.

Anthropic shares opened at $111.50, which was 34% higher than the IPO price of $83 fixed on Wednesday. Shares of the world’s first publicly traded frontier AI company ended the day at $97.17, up 17% from its IPO price. However, the stock was down 7.25% at $90.23 per share during the pre-market trading session.

Amid huge buzz around Anthropic IPO, the issue was also compared with Elon Musk’s SpaceX, which went public in June. Retail investors traded nearly $772 million of Anthropic shares on Thursday, the most for an IPO debut since Vanda Research began tracking the data in 2012, reported Bloomberg.

At the IPO price of $83 per share, Anthropic and its founders raised nearly $300 million and $801 million, respectively, through the dedicated offerings in Britain and on the continent. The UK offering attracted nearly $1 billion of orders, Bloomberg reported, citing a person familiar with the matter.
